scope: Live rate, binding, NAV, capacity and gas EMA reads plus source review and adapter unit suites. Not a complete independent security audit; no live changes in this check.

findings.finding: Time-based market uses 31536000 slots/year; deployed adapter uses 126144000 and reports 1774 bps rather than 443. Source fix tested but not deployed.
Configured capacity=0 means unlimited to adapter deposit but maxCapacity() returns 0; strategy interprets zero as no room. Underlying four markets report positive maxDeposit.
lastGoodApyBps has no writer in source; all five deployed market caches are zero despite nonzero active PPS yield, breaking internal yield ranking and cache fallback.

pokeAPYSnapshots replaces the comparison baseline with current PPS and time; same-timestamp currentAPYBps becomes zero with no override (Morpho fallback caches are also zero). Fluid and Dolomite snapshot rates have no maximum-age guard.
Rate APIs use APY naming but largely report simple annualized APR or historical PPS growth, not consistent compounded forward APY.
Venus deposit EMA=297811, all other observed deposit/withdraw EMAs zero. Current 2m/3m floors dominate, even for measured Venus deposit.
